title: Account Types & Suitability

rows: Undivided equal interest; common for spouses
Passes to surviving tenant(s), avoids probate
Decedent's % → estate (frozen until paperwork); survivors continue
Bypasses probate (not estate tax); JTWROS TOD triggers after LAST death

sections.heading: POA Quick Rules
items: FPOA = deposit/withdraw + trade; LPOA = trade only (no withdrawals)
Durable POA = survives incapacity, but ALL POAs END at DEATH of either party
POA granted to a PERSON, not a firm; fiduciary duty applies

sections.heading: Custodial (UGMA/UTMA) Rules
items: CASH ONLY — no margin, no short sales, no naked options (covered calls OK)
1 custodian + 1 minor per account; donor can be custodian
Taxed at minor's rate; minor's SSN
UTMA: can hold real estate, held until 21–25 depending on state
UGMA: no real estate, released at age of majority
Custodian may be reimbursed for expenses (compensation only if NOT the donor)

sections.heading: Trusts
items: Living trust = funded while grantor alive; Decedent's = funded after death
Revocable: grantor controls, assets STAY in estate (taxable)
Irrevocable: grantor gives up control, REMOVED from estate (grantor can't be trustee/beneficiary)
Margin only if trust document specifically permits

rows: 10% on gains only; principal always tax-free

sections.heading: IRA Numbers & Rules
items: Contributions from EARNED income only (not dividends/interest)
Traditional + Roth share COMBINED annual limit; catch-up $1,000 at age 50+
Rollover: 60 calendar days, ONE per rolling 12 months (across all IRAs)
Transfer (custodian-to-custodian): unlimited
Excess contribution penalty: 6% per year until removed
Missed RMD penalty: 50% of shortfall
Penalty exceptions (59½): death, disability, $10K 1st home, education, medical
PROHIBITED in IRA: collectibles, life insurance, short sales, margin, muni bonds, speculative options

rows: Employer bears investment risk; formula-based payout
Employee defers salary; employee bears risk

sections.heading: Cash vs Margin (Reg T)
items: Reg T = 50% initial margin requirement (issued by FRB)
FINRA initial minimum: $2,000 OR 100% of purchase if less
Initial deposit = GREATER of 50% Reg T or $2,000 FINRA min
Maintenance: 25% long / 30% short (FINRA); house calls can be stricter
Payment due T+4 under Reg T (T+2 settlement + 2 days)
Required forms: Credit Agreement + Hypothecation Agreement (mandatory); Loan Consent (OPTIONAL)
MUST be cash only: IRAs, all retirement plans, UGMA/UTMA, custodial
Marginable: listed stocks/bonds, Nasdaq, warrants; NOT marginable at purchase: options, rights, new issues, mutual funds (mutual funds & new issues become collateral after 30 days)

sections.heading: Discretionary vs Non-Discretionary
items: 3 A's of Discretion: Action (buy/sell), Amount (shares/$), Asset (which security)
If RR chooses ANY of the 3 A's → discretionary trade
Time & Price alone = NOT discretion
Required: written customer authorization + written principal approval BEFORE first trade
Each discretionary trade must be marked 'discretionary' and reviewed promptly by principal
Discretion granted to PERSON (RR), not the firm — ends if RR leaves

sections.heading: KYC / Suitability Essentials
items: Required at account opening: name, SSN/TIN, DOB, address, employment, citizenship, ID verification
Financial: income, net worth, liquid net worth, tax status
Investment: objectives, time horizon, risk tolerance, experience, liquidity needs
Solicited trades must be marked solicited; mismarking = violation
Principal must approve new accounts in writing

rows: Money market, listed stocks (NOT DPPs, real estate)

common_traps: JTWROS = undivided equal interest; TIC = specified % (can be unequal) — decedent's % goes to ESTATE in TIC, to survivors in JTWROS
ALL POAs end at death — including DURABLE POAs (durable only survives incapacity, NOT death)
Custodial account assets pass to the MINOR's estate if minor dies, NOT to parent/custodian
Roth IRA principal is ALWAYS tax-free on withdrawal; only gains face tax/penalty if non-qualified. No RMDs on Roth.
IRA rollover = 60 days, ONE per 12 months across ALL IRAs; transfers (custodian-to-custodian) are unlimited
Loan Consent Agreement is OPTIONAL for margin; Credit + Hypothecation are MANDATORY
Letting RR choose time/price is NOT discretion — only Action/Amount/Asset triggers discretion rules
